title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY AND THE ASSISTANT EXECUTIVE SECRETARY FOR THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS MAY ADMINISTER OATHS REQUIRED BY LAW.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY AND THE ASSISTANT EXECUTIVE SECRETARY FOR THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS MAY ADMINISTER OATHS REQUIRED BY LAW.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định Thư ký Điều hành và Thư ký Điều hành Trợ lý cho Quần đảo Philippines có thể thực hiện việc tuyên thệ theo quy định của pháp luật
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้เลขาธิการฝ่ายบริหารและเลขาธิการฝ่ายบริหารช่วยสำหรับหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์สามารถปฏิบัติการสาบานตามที่กฎหมายกำหนด
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa Sekretaris Eksekutif dan Sekretaris Eksekutif Pembantu untuk Kepulauan Filipina dapat melaksanakan sumpah sesuai ketentuan undang-undang
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa Setiausaha Eksekutif dan Setiausaha Eksekutif Pembantu bagi Kepulauan Filipina boleh mengambil sumpah yang diwajibkan oleh undang-undang

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The Executive Secretary and the Assistant Executive Secretary for the Philippine Islands are
hereby empowered to administer all oaths required and authorized by law, without compensation, but they
shall not be required to administer oaths except in matters of official business in which no fees are
chargeable by law.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 24, 1903.
